Visit note | 2026-04-09 03:30 PM | Dr. Saiful Alam, Endocrinology | Patient: Habib Faruque, 32, male. Mr. Faruque attends for a review of his condition and reports experiencing a racing heart and shaky hands. He is an NGO field officer and first noticed these symptoms when his clothes became loose during a stay in Noakhali. He works actively and mentions that he feels muscle weakness when climbing stairs with no palpitations. He denies chest pain, heat intolerance, or sweating. On examination: pulse 117 bpm, BP 131/85 mmHg, weight 47 kg. Thyroid gland is slightly enlarged and smooth without nodules. Assessment: Hyperthyroidism. Plan: a prescription was issued to manage his hormone levels. He was advised to avoid excess tea and coffee and to rest whenever his heart races. Follow-up in 4 weeks with thyroid function tests.

Visit note | 2026-04-09 04:30 PM | Dr. Jannatul Ferdous, Orthopedics | Patient: Manik Nath, 52, male. Visit note | 2026-04-11 09:30 AM | Dr. Shamima Nasrin, Ophthalmology | Patient: Gopal Bhattacharya, 50, male.
